title: Rings and Jewelry for AOaM
description: Basic mod that allows you to create Rings and Jewelry out of items from "Armor, Ores, and More"
body:
Basic mod that lets you create [Rings and Jewelry](https://modrinth.com/mod/rings-and-jewelry) from items found in [Armor, Ores, and More](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor,-ores,-and-more).

Requires both the "Armor, Ores, and More" and the "Rings and Jewelry" mods to work properly. (obviously)
